affiliations.date_precision: The official Army-entry record carries civilian occupation code 784 on April 5, 1942; the grouped category supplies neither an employer nor a workplace.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms identity. The occupation group does not support a named employer, firm, industry, or immediate OSS predecessor.

affiliations.date_precision: The official Army-entry record carries civilian occupation code 126 on March 31, 1943; the grouped category does not distinguish among the three roles or name an employer.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms identity. The grouped code cannot support one specific role, employer, or immediate OSS predecessor.

affiliations.date_precision: The official Army-entry record carries civilian occupation code 992 on April 13, 1944; the official code table identifies students but names no institution.
affiliations.research_notes: Student status is not employment. The exact private identifier confirms identity, but the school and Army-to-OSS chronology remain unknown.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Richard C. Brooks is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact-name and private-identifier match in the official merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The full name and private service identifier match across the OSS index and official Army-entry file; the identifier is withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact private identifier and exact normalized full name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated April 5, 1942; the index documents an OSS personnel file but not the OSS transfer date.
claims.match_notes: Common-name directory, obituary, and modern professional results were rejected because they lacked the private identifier or Box 82 linkage.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry, Richard C. Brooks was recorded in the grouped occupation category 'tool sharpeners and dressers.'
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official record carries code 784; the official code list maps 7-84 to tool sharpeners and dressers.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier and full indexed name.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry on April 5, 1942; its relation to OSS recruitment remains unknown.
claims.match_notes: No employer, shop, industry, or exact day-to-day duties are inferred from the grouped code.
